policy.selectionRule: A candidate is selected only when all four requirements are proven by retained evidence. Missing, inferred, unavailable, or aspirational evidence is absent and cannot qualify a candidate.
policy.scopeRule: B09 evaluates candidates and does not add a format when the demand and maintenance gate is not satisfied.
policy.evidencePolicy: External demand links are retained as references only. No user identity, private content, or third-party asset is copied into the repository. Repository issue counts and governance claims are recorded with retrieval dates.

demandEvidence.title: Editing metadata changes the SVG document state
demandEvidence.observation: The issue documents an SVG editor workflow in which document metadata is authored and preserved as part of the SVG file, establishing a named metadata-inspection interoperability workflow.

demandEvidence.title: Feature request: export to sidecar files
demandEvidence.observation: The discussion records a named interoperability workflow for exporting descriptive metadata to XMP sidecar files. It is external ecosystem demand evidence, not a browser-image-metadata user issue or fixture grant.

demandEvidence.title: Script to fix broken EXIF metadata (Offset/TimeZone) in assets
demandEvidence.observation: The discussion documents a workflow that emits XMP sidecars for corrected capture timestamps without rewriting source assets.

demandEvidence.title: The option to write an xmp sidecar file after edit
demandEvidence.observation: The issue documents a real application workflow and operational concerns around XMP sidecar writes during metadata editing and transfer.

demandEvidence.title: Metadata: Embed XMP metadata in JPEG files
demandEvidence.observation: The issue documents application interoperability expectations for XMP title and keyword metadata, including embedded and sidecar-adjacent workflows.

candidates.name: SVG metadata
candidates.rationale: SVG metadata is selected narrowly for bounded RDF/XML inventory only. The retained evidence identifies a real editor workflow, W3C-licensed hash-pinned conformance fixture, explicit limits and fail-closed XML handling, and WBLFD governance ownership. It does not authorize SVG rendering, mutation, or sidecar XMP work.

lawfulConformanceFixtures.reason: The repository contains bounded embedded XMP and RDF/XML tests, but no pinned, lawfully redistributable sidecar-file corpus or documented real embedded/sidecar pairs that satisfy the B09 fixture gate.

boundedSecurityModel.reason: The existing RDF/XML parser and SecurityLimits model provide an applicable starting point, but that is not a completed sidecar conformance project.

maintenanceOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md records WBLFD as the B09 additional-container maintenance owner.

candidates.rationale: This is the strongest demand candidate, but it fails the lawful-fixture and governance-owner gates. It is therefore not selected and no B09 format implementation is authorized by the roadmap gate.

internalEvidence.observation: The repository issue tracker displayed zero issues at retrieval.
CONTRIBUTING.md records WBLFD as the maintenance owner for the B09 additional-container evaluation and any selected container project.
The repository already bounds RDF/XML parsing, serialization, XML features, and output through its security-limit model, but it has no completed B10 sidecar project.
The W3C SVG 1.1 Test Suite fixture metadata-example-01-t.svg is hash-pinned, remains temporary during execution, and is covered by the documented W3C Test Suite License.

SVG metadata inventory validates UTF-8/root namespaces and bounds elements, depth, attributes, metadata bytes, RDF packets, text, warnings, and output. It rejects DTD/entity declarations and leaves non-RDF metadata opaque.

nextAction: B09 is complete for bounded SVG metadata RDF/XML inventory. Proceed to B10 only under its separate sidecar-XMP acceptance criteria.
